status: specification-only; no failure injection, crash, storage or native tests executed
fixture_policy: Use R03 logical state/operation manifests and concrete candidate adapters; initial states and faults are scenario declarations, not a supplied runnable harness. Expand each relevant commit point/OS/profile before counting executions.

scenarios.title: Stale guard before mutation
scenarios.initial: Current note r2, request expects r1; authenticated edit capability.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Submit stale command while a current reader is active.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Reject without content/history/outbox effect; any recorded rejection receipt does not fabricate a content revision.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Applying stale body or treating provider latest-wins as a local guard bypass.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Concurrent duplicate reservation
scenarios.initial: No recorded op k, two clients use same semantic request k.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Race both through lookup/reservation/commit and kill one client.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: One eventual effect and one stable result identity map; both inspect the same outcome after recovery.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Two tasks/placements or two recurrence generations from lookup-then-write race.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Lost reply after durable commit
scenarios.initial: Task move k committed with original source/destination guards; response not delivered.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Drop reply, restart caller and retry identical k after revisions advanced.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Return retained outcome/known status before stale guard evaluation, with authorization; do not execute twice.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Duplicate move or new operation identity because timeout was assumed failure.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Changed payload under old identity
scenarios.initial: k already admitted/applied for destination n2.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Reuse k with destination n3 or changed task body.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: OPERATION_ID_REUSED and no new domain effect.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Returning success for changed request or overwriting retained fingerprint.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Protected input before main-store commit
scenarios.fault_point: recovery durable / current store not committed
scenarios.initial: Pending edit r1 has a verified recovery record and needed staging/asset roots; current store r0.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Terminate authority before current commit.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Current store remains valid r0; recovery discovers protected r1 with original base and explicit apply/conflict outcome.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Claiming r1 saved into current state or losing its only protected payload.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Partial immutable payload or temp write
scenarios.initial: Current root r0 valid; new payload/temp file preparation not committed.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Truncate/fail write then kill process.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: r0 remains current; incomplete staged object is never a valid committed root; cleanup checks protection before reclaim.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Opening partial payload as current or replacing original Space with empty content.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Asset durable before metadata commit
scenarios.initial: Validated image/PDF bytes reached retained durable location; reference transaction not committed.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash between asset publication and current reference/outcome commit.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Old valid content remains; possible orphan bytes are safe to collect only after root/lease revalidation.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Falsely available reference with missing bytes or eager deletion of newly needed staged roots.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: State-outcome-outbox coherence
scenarios.initial: Sync enabled; edit changes note, retained state, operation outcome and pending-publication obligation.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Inject failure at every backend boundary that could separate those roots.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: After recovery either old valid effect set or new valid committed set; a durable saved edit has outcome/dedup protection and publication intent.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Saved state with forgotten upload or re-executable accepted operation; half-task move.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Uncertain commit return
scenarios.initial: A commit attempt may have crossed visibility boundary; no reliable durable outcome returned.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Lose storage reply or inject flush failure/uncertain write result.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Retain pending/recovery roots, report uncertain/unconfirmed and inspect original operation/root; return definitive rejection only when no effect proved.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Blind new-ID retry or unqualified durable success while effect/flush is unknown.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Commit before notification/index update
scenarios.initial: Current r1/outcome durable, subscribers/index at r0.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash/drop notification and cancel derived update.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Reopen/catch up authoritative r1; index rebuild/freshness exposes its lag; duplicate events do not duplicate content.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Lost canonical task because only an index/event stored it or stale query claimed current.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Older save cleanup racing new input
scenarios.initial: Saving r1 while r2 pending/protected in same entity/context.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Complete r1 durable acknowledgement and scheduled recovery cleanup after r2 input.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Remove only protection no longer required; r2 remains pending/protected and saved indicator names r1 correctly.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Deleting r2 recovery because r1 save succeeded or reporting r2 durable.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Out-of-order recovery records
scenarios.initial: Newer recovery generation r2 already durable; delayed r1 record/remove still queued.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Deliver old write/remove last then restart.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: r2 protection wins by record generation/revision; obsolete callback cannot erase it.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Old snapshot replacing newer typing or stale cleanup releasing current asset roots.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Recovery while owner is still active
scenarios.initial: Window B opens while A owns live dirty/protected work.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Scan recovery records and simulate delayed owner heartbeat without proven owner death.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Do not offer/apply live-owned work as abandoned; failed takeover is explicit and non-destructive.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Stale timestamp/PID alone authorizes replacing active session or cleanup.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Authority takeover fences old writer
scenarios.initial: Old authority loses ownership; new authority may start only under proved exclusivity.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Pause/resume old process across takeover; submit old lease write and receipt callbacks.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: At most one local writable authority; old writes rejected/fenced and outcomes reconciled.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Two local cores independently accepting writes to same replica or old flush reviving deleted state.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Task move at every commit point
scenarios.initial: t1 in n1, body/properties/history retained, n2 destination validated.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash before/within/after source and destination publication.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: One coherent old location or committed new location; no active duplicate/orphan and stable TaskId/body/history after restart. After durable move acknowledgement, only the committed new location is valid under the claimed failure profile.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Per-note successes create two t1 owners or delete the sole body.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Note delete and restore closure
scenarios.initial: n1 owns t1/t2; inbox t3 unrelated; history/assets complete.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Interrupt note deletion and later guarded restore at each closure boundary.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Current and retained manifests coherent: n1/t1/t2 old or deleted/restored set, t3 untouched; tombstones valid.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Partial cascade reported successful or restoration duplicates moved historical task.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Recurring completion replay
scenarios.initial: Recurring Monday task completed after missed slot; next occurrence not yet accepted or already created by same transition.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash/retry completion; replay resulting provider package and conflicting stale transition.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: At most one next future occurrence for that transition, distinct TaskId/empty body; completed content retained; no replay-driven regeneration.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Two next tasks or deletion of independent next-occurrence edits during unsafe inverse.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Pin races garbage collection
scenarios.initial: Historical manifest and dependencies exist; GC has old unpinned candidate set.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Pin then allow old sweep; inject a new root immediately after sweep revalidation but before unlink. Also race pin after payload unavailable.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Successful pin protects full reconstructable closure; if already unavailable, pin fails honestly. Authority fence or proved generation handshake prevents root-add/check/unlink race, not just a one-time root check.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Pinned success with collected task body, comment state or media.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Undo/export lease roots after unpin
scenarios.initial: Version unpinned but active context undo/export/recovery still needs an asset or state.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Run retention and expire an unrelated timer while owner still active.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Retain roots while needed under valid lease; unpin is not immediate purge; owner fencing protects legitimate concurrent use.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Time-only cleanup removes bytes under active reader/undo context.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Historical task state stays historical
scenarios.initial: Pinned n1 version references t1 body Old; current t1 body New lives in n2.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Compact/migrate/read historical version.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Read Old from manifest-owned state references; current New/n2 unchanged; pinned closure reconstructable.
scenarios.forbidden_result: History resolves task through current body or moves it back as side effect of reading.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Restore plan becomes stale
scenarios.initial: Restore plan read current location; t1 moves/changes before plan commit.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Commit old plan then restart.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Reject/replan current ownership/revision conflict or apply only an explicitly reauthorized valid closure; old version immutable.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Blind rewind/duplicate placement from stale plan or partial restore marked success.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Coherent snapshot with concurrent assets
scenarios.initial: Writer changes entity/version/asset roots while export snapshot requested.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Capture metadata snapshot, race asset GC/new commits, finish/cancel export.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Manifest is one declared coherent cut with required bytes protected until completion/cancel release; excluded scopes explicit.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Copied DB alone described as complete Space backup/export or asset roots freed midstream.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Process versus OS/power durability
scenarios.initial: r1 was acknowledged saved under a declared durability profile; r2 pending.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Run process kill separately from actual qualified OS/power/storage interruption.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Every acknowledged r1 survives the claimed failure class with coherent outcomes/roots; r2 expectations follow its actual protection status. Higher profile is blocked until native evidence exists.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Counting process kill as power proof or losing acknowledged r1 while still advertising that profile.
scenarios.scope: all-candidate contract; OS/power-profile pass requires native/storage evidence, not Linux mock or clean kill

scenarios.title: Interrupted migration and decoder retention
scenarios.initial: Old store and pinned retained versions readable; new codec migration staged.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Fail at preparation/root switch/cleanup; reopen supported/older client variants.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Choose verified compatible state without silent acknowledged loss; IDs/required history/assets/outcomes retained; unsupported writer refuses.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Auto-empty Space, unreadable pinned history or old client writes destructive downgrade.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Derived index corruption
scenarios.initial: Canonical state/history intact; search/task/backlink/parse cache invalid.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Delete/truncate indexes or alter fingerprint/version.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Rebuild from canonical revisions; query lag explicit; no canonical task/body/property lost. Diagnose any backend integrity discrepancy.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Rebuild treats cached projection as source or silently edits current content to fit index.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Canonical root/receipt/history corruption
scenarios.initial: Canonical object/root/outcome manifest missing/corrupt, not merely an index.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Open and request write/recovery.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Preserve original/protected work, refuse unsafe writes and label degraded/read-only recovery; no false newest/durable claim.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Recreate empty Space, delete journal to open or silently roll back acknowledged content.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Upload succeeded but local ack lost
scenarios.initial: Stable publication/state/assets prepared; provider accepts transfer.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash before local ack/progress persist, then retry.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Retry same publication safely; no duplicated task generation/history loss; keep roots until scoped acknowledgement/protection proved.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Mark all devices synced, remove sole local roots on staging only, or new publication identity recreates effect.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Inbound cursor before/after ingest
scenarios.initial: Received remote winner and required overwritten local state need retention; cursor r0.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash around content/history commit and cursor advance; replay package including missing-asset variant.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: No skip of uncommitted data; replay idempotent with both history states retained, missing dependencies pending, no outbound echo/regeneration.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Cursor says caught up while winner/history absent or incomplete media described available.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Disk full/access loss and shutdown
scenarios.initial: Pending accepted work; force disk full/write grant loss before and after visibility/flush.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Close final view/authority, request CLI durable completion and restart.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: Protect/recover pending work; distinguish proven no-effect from uncertain/unconfirmed; normal successful close needs no extra dialog. Explicit loss override remains Q-08.
scenarios.forbidden_result: False saved/synced state, blind retry or dropping protected work just because window closed.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

scenarios.title: Identity/tombstone retirement
scenarios.initial: Old accepted operation and deleted task identity may be referenced by offline/retry state.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Compact then retry old operation/deliver stale provider state; vary new lease/epoch and denied caller.
scenarios.restart_or_observation: No re-execution/resurrection without valid new intent; expired/unknown status and reconcile path explicit. R05 must qualify offline replica retirement proof.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Detail eviction authorizes old op again, file absence guesses a delete, or stale task becomes second active placement.
scenarios.scope: all-candidates; native profile still requires actual native evidence

global_acknowledgement_rule: Old-or-new restart alternatives apply only before durable acknowledgement/when completion is uncertain. Every acknowledged durable revision must survive the declared failure class. Do not mark a rollback pass merely because an older root is coherent.
